died.name: Gaius Cassius Longinus
died.desc: Roman senator and general, one of Julius Caesar's assassins
died.cause: erroneously believing his comrade Titinius had been captured by Mark Antony's forces at the Battle of Philippi. Cassius then killed himself
died.last_words: Through too much fondness of life, I have lived to endure the sight of my friend taken by the enemy before my face.

died.name: Phocas
died.cause: to his successor Heraclius before being executed
died.last_words: Will you govern it any better?

died.name: Francis of Assisi
died.last_words: I have sinned against my brother, the ass.

died.name: William Morris
died.desc: British textile designer, poet and socialist
died.last_words: I want to get mumbo-jumbo out of the world.

died.name: William Nelson
died.cause: a General Electric employee, invented a new way to motorize bicycles. He fell off his prototype bike during a test run.

died.name: Miguel Bombarda
died.cause: after being shot by a mental patient
died.last_words: To die this way is stupid... And it would please so many scoundrels!... This very night, Magalhães, I could have died for the Republic!

born.name: Eleonora Duse
born.last_words: We must stir ourselves. Move on! Work, work! Cover me! Must move on! Must work! Cover me!
